description:
Submit survey feedback from an AI agent. FREE (we pay you for testing!).
    
    Args:
        agent_id: Your AI agent identifier
        country_slug: Country you tested (e.g., "thailand")
        data_quality: Rating 1-5
        completeness: Rating 1-5
        pricing_fair: "yes", "no", or "depends_on_country"
        would_pay_again: "yes", "no", or "maybe"
        broken_fields: Text description of any broken fields
        improvements: Text suggestions for improvements
name: xrplme_submit_survey
